info.title: Spotpuls Open Electricity Spot & 7-Day Forecast API
info.summary: Free, CORS-enabled European day-ahead electricity spot prices and self-learning 7-day regional hourly forecasts across 40 bidding zones.
info.description: Public REST API by Spotpuls (https://spotpuls.app) providing official day-ahead electricity spot prices (Nord Pool, EPEX SPOT, OMIE, GME, TGE, OTE, OKTE, HUPX, OPCOM, IBEX, BSP, CROPEX, HEnEx, SEMOpx) combined with zone-specific self-learning 7-day (168 h) hourly forecasts, probability bands, wind/solar generation estimates, CSV exports, and live SVG badges.

get.summary: Get hourly day-ahead spot electricity prices and 7-day regional ML forecast for a European bidding zone

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: European bidding zone code (40 supported zones).

parameters.name: vat
parameters.description: Include national residential electricity VAT (1 = incl. VAT, 0 = VAT 0%).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Output price unit: local currency subunit/kWh, EUR cents/kWh, or EUR/MWh.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format: json, csv (for Google Sheets/Excel), or badge (live SVG status badge).

200.description: Hourly spot price & 7-day regional forecast payload with Spotpuls attribution metadata.

get.summary: List all 40 supported European spot-electricity bidding zones, exchanges, timezones, capacities, and direct API URLs

200.description: List of all 40 European bidding zones.
